entry.title: Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots
entry.summary: Wearing cameras and sensor gloves, the startup’s human chemists will train robots to perform various lab tasks.

entry.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
entry.summary: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

entry.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
entry.summary: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

entry.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
entry.summary: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

entry.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
entry.summary: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

entry.title: The secret to fast startup growth isn’t early sales, top names in tech say
entry.summary: At this year’s Disrupt, Lovable GTM lead Luke Arno, Polsia's Ben Broca, and Theory Ventures’ Tomasz Tunguz gave founders some tips on how to achieve true sales success in the first 90 days.

entry.title: Arc browser sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia
entry.summary: Arc was fiercely beloved by a dedicated group of enthusiasts, but it never quite became the mass-market Chrome alternative its makers once envisioned.

entry.title: Rivian buys world model startup to accelerate self-driving ambitions
entry.summary: Third Dimension's technology uses AI to match the physical world, which when combined with Rivian's reams of data could turn into a valuable simulator.

entry.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
entry.summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

entry.title: As blockchain investing falls out of vogue, a16z Crypto rebrands as a16z Frontier
entry.summary: The digital asset unit, helmed by Chris Dixon, broadens its scope.

entry.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear
entry.summary: Warhound, the brainchild of Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, emerges from stealth to genetically engineer dogs for military and law enforcement.

entry.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta
entry.summary: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.

entry.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
entry.summary: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

entry.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia
entry.summary: The company plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.

entry.title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its US smart ring comeback
entry.summary: Oura alleges in its newest lawsuit that Ultrahuman's Ring Pro infringes two of its patents.

entry.title: Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients’ personal and health data was compromised during breach
entry.summary: Quest is the latest in a series of healthcare technology companies that have been hacked in recent months.

entry.title: What some of Anthropic’s backers are reportedly worth before its IPO
entry.summary: Early-stage and follow-on investors in the AI lab are already sitting on major paper returns.

entry.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85M to build better fusion-ready semiconductors
entry.summary: Top-funded fusion startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems received an $85 million award from the federal government to advance conductors for fusion power plants.

entry.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
entry.summary: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

entry.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
entry.summary: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.
